title: How to Revoke Token Approvals (Before a Drainer Empties Your Wallet)
description:
Most drained crypto wallets never leak a seed phrase. The owner signs the theft with one click. Here's how to check which apps can spend your tokens right now, revoke them for free on revoke.cash, and read wallet pop-ups so it doesn't happen to you.

Chapters
0:00 Most drained wallets never leak a seed phrase
0:36 What a token approval actually is
1:24 How wallet drainers use approvals and permits
2:40 Check who can spend your tokens (revoke.cash, Etherscan)
3:39 Revoke what you don't use (and what it costs)
4:46 Read the pop-up before you click
5:35 Habits: two wallets, bookmarks, monthly check
6:10 The whole video in one breath

The checklist
1. Open revoke.cash (type it yourself) and paste your wallet address. No wallet connection needed to look.
2. Check every network you've used: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Polygon.
3. Red flags: Unlimited allowances, spenders you don't recognise, apps you used once.
4. Connect, click Revoke, confirm. Allowance goes back to 0. Small gas fee.
5. Before signing anything: what type (approve, setApprovalForAll, permit = spending), who is the spender, how much.
6. Keep a small hot wallet for new apps and a vault (ideally hardware) for savings.
7. Once a month: revoke.cash, paste, clean up. Two minutes.

Sources
Scam Sniffer 2025 Crypto Phishing Scam Report: about $83.85M lost to wallet drainer phishing in 2025, 106,106 victims, largest single theft $6.5M from a Permit signature; about $494M in 2024.
